visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair tied back, wearing a black mesh inner top and a bulky beige fur-textured coat, stands in front of a plain white wall. She looks directly at the camera with a neutral-to-friendly expression, moving her hands and fingers while white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The woman holds three pink, round makeup compacts with a quilted leather texture and a gold YSL logo. A close-up shows a single compact held in a hand. Then, a hand is shown rubbing a pink powder onto the skin of a wrist. (3) The woman uses her fingers to gesture an 'O' shape around her eye and cheek. She then uses a black makeup brush to apply pink powder from a compact onto her cheekbones in a circular motion. A slogan appears at the top left. (4) The woman gestures with her fingers pointing towards the outer corner of her eye and her temple. She uses the brush to apply blush in an upward sweeping motion towards her hairline. New slogans appear at the top. (5) She makes a 'V' or 'Peace' sign near her eyes and applies blush directly onto the under-eye area. She poses with her hand on her chin, looking at the camera. (6) A close-up of a forearm is shown with five distinct stripes of makeup swatches ranging from soft pink to deeper coral, with text labels next to each swatch. (7) The woman poses with different makeup looks, holding the pink compact to her cheek and smiling. She finishes by pointing to her cheeks and speaking to the camera, with the beige coat filling the frame.
